title: Podkletnov rumored to work for an American contractor
summary: Salvatore Pais tells of Podkletnov rumored to work for an American contractor, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: once upon a time I was told he was working for an American contractor

plain: A Navy scientist, Salvatore Pais, who holds patents on unusual technology, says he was once told that a researcher named Eugene Podkletnov was working for an American contractor, meaning a private company that does work for the government. Pais passes it on as something he heard, and it would mean Podkletnov's work had caught the interest of the American defence world.
